messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — severity: SEV2 — inference-prod — elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency. Auto-created war room: https://warroom.redwood.dev/r/IR-1715009999 · Paging on-call now :rotating_light:

alex: ack I'm on call, joining war room now. joining link: https://warroom.redwood.dev/r/IR-1715009999 · starting triage

oncall-bot: Pager acknowledged by alex · reminder set for 15m

maria: assigning incident owner -> alex. tagging l2-ops and product-support. quick impact check: are customers seeing 5xx for all models or a subset?

samir: quick look — error spike concentrated on model-gpu-pool-3 (north-1). pods are restarting, OOMKilled on the model runner process. p95 went from ~220ms to ~1.3s, 5xx rate peaked ~12%. logs snippet:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/model-gpu-runner -l pool=model-gpu-pool-3 --tail=200 | grep -i oom
# repeated 'Killed process 4321 (runner) total-vm: 2576000kB'
```

alex: thanks. mitigation plan in chat: 1) scale model-gpu-pool-3 +2 replicas, 2) enable fallback routing to region-west for non-latency-critical requests, 3) disable large-batch scheduling on that pool, 4) collect heap profiles if OOMs continue. executing scale now:```bash
redwoodctl pools scale --name=model-gpu-pool-3 --replicas=6 --region=north-1
```

samir: ran scale command — kubernetes accepted, new pods spinning up. also pushing a temporary resource bump to the deployment:```bash
kubectl patch deploy model-gpu-runner -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runner","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"12Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```

alex: scaling looks green, new pods Ready=2/2. early telemetry: p95 dropped from 1300ms -> 380ms; 5xx went from 12% -> 3%. still higher than baseline but improving. starting traffic shift to region-west for non-critical routes:```yaml
# routing override
routing:
  inference-api:
    route_by: priority
    fallbacks:
      - region: west-1
        percent: 30
```

product-support: draft status page / customer note — use this and mark affected services: inference API generation endpoints, embeddings are unaffected.

maria: please post this to status.redwood.ai as "Investigating" then update to "Identified" once mitigation shows sustained improvement. draft below:

product-support: "Status update (investigating): We are currently investigating elevated error rates and increased latency impacting generation requests in north-1. Some customers may experience failed requests or degraded response times. Engineers are actively mitigating and we will provide an update within 15 minutes. (IR-1715009999)"

alex: posted initial status page update. customer-facing slack/message template below for accounts team if asked: 

product-support: "Hi <customer>, we observed elevated error rates impacting generation requests in north-1. We’ve deployed scaling and routing mitigations and are seeing reduced errors. We’ll follow up when the incident is fully resolved and include a postmortem. If you’re experiencing an urgent outage, reply and we’ll prioritize your tenant."

l2-ops: suggest we enable KV cache pinning for top models to reduce memory churn if OOMs recur. prepping a short-runbook entry.

samir: running heap/profile capture on one of the restarting pods now — attaching command:```bash
kubectl exec -n inference model-gpu-runner-xyz -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap.pb"
kubectl cp inference/model-gpu-runner-xyz:/tmp/heap.pb ./heap-1715009999.pb
```

alex: got profile, sharing in war room. early suspicion: memory leak in recent runtime change that increases KV cache retention for long-prefixes.

maria: good catch. open ticket for runtime team for a roll-forward/rollback decision. keep escalation on if errors climb above 5%.

samir: metrics update — 5xx now 1.8%, p95 250ms (close to baseline). errors seem concentrated on tenant-heavy requests with large context sizes.

alex: changing incident state to MONITORING in war room. will leave war room open for 30m — if stable, final update and move to postmortem planning.

product-support: updating status page to "Monitoring — We have implemented mitigations and error rates have decreased. Some customers may still observe intermittent failures; full service restored for most traffic. Next update in 60 minutes or when resolved."

maria: quick action items: 1) runtime team to triage memory retention flag, 2) ops to add autoscale headroom on pool for 24h, 3) comms to impacted customers with ETA for postmortem. tagging owners: @samir runtime triage, @l2-ops autoscale, @product-support customer comms

tess: I can take the handoff at 12:30 UTC. notes for next on-call: war room link, status page updates, heap/profile in war room artifacts, scaling commands used. handoff doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/IR-1715009999-handoff

oncall-bot: Reminder set: handoff at 12:30 UTC to tess

alex: handing off to tess. leaving war room open for follow-up and postmortem kick-off. thanks team. :team-heart:

incident-bot: Incident IR-1715009999 moved to MONITORING — no active pager. Last update: 5xx rate reduced to ~1.8%, p95 near baseline. Postmortem scheduled.
